reason: History composes one Saved submissions section: its current client/history gate, native row fields, count and notes, refresh control, and the existing removal confirmation. Native data validation/source revisions live in submission-view/queries, and selection/dispatch/uncertainty live in useSubmissionRemoval. The markup preserves the authored desktop/phone hierarchy and never owns capability transport or lifecycle.

The hook owns one selected removal review: open/close, pending exclusion, native action invocation, current refusal reconciliation, and exact current feedback/cache publication. createRemovalReview separately binds actor/client/history revisions and the session-local uncertainty fence; actions.ts separately owns native preflight/DELETE/receipt parsing, and RemoveSubmission owns layout/focus. Its branches share the same selected-review lifetime invariant; splitting them would duplicate that coordination.

CapabilitiesPage retains its existing page composition, capability selection query, fit/editor/registration entries and navigation. This change adds only the PastPerformance public entry and clarifies the Advocacy history label. Saved client/history reads and removal state remain wholly inside the client-profile public feature. No second service, mutation or identity owner enters this page.
